about_the_game:
Drop the ball. Upgrade your world. Watch the chaos unfold.

PlinkIdle is a retro-inspired game with an idle/incremental spin on a classic ball drop mechanic.  It starts with a simple ball drop, but the world is quickly upgraded as progress unlocks upgrades, buffs, new stages, and more.

A Classic Game of Chance, Reimagined

Balls bounce through peg boards with the chance of making it into the max bucket. Every coin and ball earned can be spent on upgrades to crank up the chaos and increase the long term earnings. Boost your drop rate, multiply rewards, and transform each stage with peg upgrades, rare balls, and splitters.

Rare balls multiply coins against everything they touch:

  • Common: 1x

  • Uncommon (green): 2x

  • Rare (blue): 5x

  • Epic (purple): 10x

  • Legendary (gold): 100x

Rare-spawning Gold Coins give temporary buffs like multipliers, Multiball, or Legendary (all balls turn gold briefly).

Buckets upgrade as they fill, returning more balls and coins the longer you play.

Adventure Through Themed Stages

Each stage is its own little world, from cozy fields under gentle rain, to glowing underground caverns, bright seas, and even outer space. Every stage has tiers to complete; finish all tiers to unlock upgrades and new stages with fresh challenges and increasing rewards.

Unlocking new stages also triggers a new stacking buff. Spin the wheel or select a stacking buff to boost your game for the remainder of the run.

Achievements and Progression

Achievements are earned passively through play, but every five achievements completed will trigger a multiplier for balls and coins that are carried throughout the game, even after Prestige.

Prestige when you've earned enough balls to multiply your next run even further.

Cozy Chaos Meets Idle Play

Play actively: chase those rare spawns and hold down the drop button for maximum momentum.

Or relax with idle: sit back and let the auto-drop do its thing while you enjoy the ASMR of falling balls.

PlinkIdle mixes chaotic energy and cozy vibes, engaging when you want to focus, and soothing when you want to step away.

⸻

PlinkIdle Features

  • Pixel Art Aesthetic – Hand-crafted retro visuals, full of charm and personality.

  • Random With Depth – Pegs, buckets, and balls all upgradeable for endless build variety.

  • Themed Stages – Rainy fields, snowy forests, electric night, and more to unlock.

  • Spin the Wheel – Buffs that stack for lasting power.

  • Rare Spawns – Gold coins and rare balls that multiply for massive wins.

  • Achievement System – Track your progress and push for 100%.

  • ASMR Bonus – Relaxing bops, plinks, and retro sound effects that create a white noise machine.

  • Idle or Active – Play hands-on or let the game run itself.

⸻

PlinkIdle is all about turning simple drops into big adventures. Whether you’re in it for the upgrades, the rare finds, or just the cozy rhythm of balls bouncing on pegs, there’s always another reason to hit “drop” one more time.

Sit back, click, and let the chaos begin.

linux_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Ubuntu 20.04 LTS (64-bit) or newer
  • Processor: Intel Core i3 or AMD equivalent
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: OpenGL 3.2+ / Vulkan compatible GPU with 1 GB VRAM
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
  • Sound Card: Any
  • Additional Notes: Tested on Ubuntu and SteamOS. Other modern 64-bit distros may work but are not officially supported.

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: macOS 11 (Big Sur) or later
  • Processor: Apple M1 or Intel Core M or later
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: 4 GB RAM
  • Storage: 300 MB available space
